question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Grit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"grit"** means having courage and resolve; strength of character. (साहस और संकल्प)

 
 
• **Example:** She showed true **grit **by continuing to work despite the difficulties.
 
 
 
• **"Courage"** refers to the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery. (साहस)
 
 
• **Example:** It takes a lot of** courage** to stand up for what you believe in.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nerveless** (हलका): Lacking strength or courage.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave a nerveless performance under pressure.
 
 
 
• **Pulse** (नाड़ी): A rhythmical throbbing of the arteries as blood is propelled through them.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt her pulse quicken with excitement.
 
 
 
• **Unnerved** (घबराया हुआ): Make someone lose courage or confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** The unexpected question unnerved him.
